intro.h2: Home remodeling in Waco with a personal touch
paragraphs: Split Rock Remodeling LLC handles home remodeling in Waco, from full master bathrooms to laundry and mud rooms to kitchens. Its Instagram bio describes a Waco business offering all of your home remodeling needs as well as custom fine woodworking items.

The reviews read like notes to friends. One family loved seeing Johnathan and his wife at the house, and so did the dogs. Another homeowner had both bathrooms redone and praised the hard work and attention to detail. A third did a full master bath and a laundry and mud room and called the team experienced, communicative and friendly. The owners answer their reviews by name.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Kitchen remodeling is one of the main services Split Rock lists. One kitchen on its Google profile pairs sage-green shaker cabinets with a walnut-wrapped range hood, white herringbone tile, a pot filler and a bright yellow range set against floral wallpaper.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling

about.h2: Meet Johnathan and the Split Rock team
about.text: Split Rock Remodeling LLC is a Waco business that takes on remodeling and custom fine woodworking. Reviewers name Johnathan and his wife as the people they worked with, and the owner replies on Google read the same way: they remember the family, the pups and the projects. One homeowner had the team remodel her family's home and said she would recommend them 1000 times. Others came for bathrooms, a laundry room and a mud room. All 8 Google reviews are five stars.
about.owner_role: Named with his wife by a reviewer; last name and title not published

process.h2: How a remodel with Split Rock works

steps.title: Call for an estimate
steps.text: The Instagram bio says it plainly: call 254-315-6551 for an estimate. Phone hours are Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM.

steps.title: Talk through the rooms
steps.text: Walk through the bathroom, kitchen, laundry or mud room you want changed, and mention any custom woodworking you have in mind.

steps.title: Plan the work
steps.text: Agree on the layout, finishes and the order of the rooms before work starts, especially when several projects are planned together.

steps.title: Build and keep in touch
steps.text: Split Rock does the work. Reviewers describe a communicative, friendly team that pays attention to details and gets along with the family.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: Look over the finished rooms together. One family said they were very pleased with how everything looked when all of their projects were complete.

service_area.text: Split Rock Remodeling describes itself on Instagram as a Waco business. Google does not show a street address or a mapped service area, so if you live outside Waco and want to know whether your home is in range, call 254-315-6551 or email splitrockremodeling@gmail.com with your town and the rooms you want remodeled. The listed hours are Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM, and photos of the space help the first conversation.

faq.h2: Questions about remodeling with Split Rock

items.q: What kinds of projects does Split Rock take on?
items.a: Reviews mention a whole-home remodel, two bathrooms, a full master bathroom, and a laundry and mud room. The listed services include kitchen remodeling, bathroom remodeling and countertops, and the Instagram bio adds custom fine woodworking items. Call to describe your project and ask whether it fits.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Call 254-315-6551 for an estimate, as the Split Rock Instagram bio says, or email splitrockremodeling@gmail.com. Have a few photos of the room ready and a rough idea of what you want changed, so the first conversation can cover the details of your project.

Split Rock keeps weekday hours, 8 AM to 5 PM Monday to Friday, and is closed on weekends. Calls during those hours are the quickest way to reach the team. Email is fine any time, and you can attach photos of the space you want remodeled.

items.q: Can you remodel more than one room at a time?
items.a: Yes, several clients have. One family did a full master bathroom and a laundry and mud room, and another had both bathrooms done. A third had the team remodel their home across several projects and said they were very pleased when everything was complete.

items.q: Do you only work in Waco?
items.a: Split Rock describes itself as a Waco business, and Google does not list a separate service area. If you live nearby but outside Waco, call 254-315-6551 or send an email with your town and project and ask whether it is within reach.

final_cta.text: Call Split Rock Remodeling for an estimate, Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM.
